label: DATING AGAIN

points.heading: Ask open questions
points.body: Questions with more than a yes-or-no answer keep a chat going.
points.panel: “What’s been the best part of your week?”

points.heading: Match the energy, gently
points.body: You don’t need to reply instantly or write paragraphs.
points.panel: Reply when you’re free, at about the length you received.

points.heading: Be a little playful
points.body: A light, warm tone reads as confidence.

points.heading: Move it off the screen
points.body: Texting is for connecting. Real chemistry shows in person.
points.panel: “I’m enjoying this. Want to grab coffee Saturday?”

resource.name: Text Chemistry
resource.covers: Ideas for texting with more confidence while you’re getting to know someone.

caption:
So much of dating happens in the texts now, and it’s easy to overthink every word.

These four habits take some of the pressure off. If you’d like more ideas for texting with confidence while you get to know someone, there’s a resource at the link in bio. It’s a place to start, and no resource can promise how someone will respond.

Follow @roundabloom for more gentle steps.
